subject.title: [Bug]: Feishu DM sessions rebuilt after gateway restart — duplicate keys + maintenance pruning

question: Should Feishu direct-message continuity be fixed with TTL-aware direct-DM maintenance protection plus Feishu `open_id` validation/doctor repair, or should OpenClaw keep the current workaround-only behavior?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the durable session-retention and malformed-identity repair choices can change store growth, split history, and affect existing Feishu multi-account deployments.

options.title: TTL-aware protection plus Feishu repair
options.body: Protect active or recent direct DM sessions from maintenance while adding Feishu `open_id` validation and a doctor or migration path for malformed existing keys.

options.title: Blanket-protect direct DMs
options.body: Never prune direct DM sessions automatically, which avoids eviction but accepts unbounded growth for bots with many one-time DMers.

options.title: Keep workaround only
options.body: Continue documenting `per-account-channel-peer` and higher caps as the operator path, leaving malformed-key and stale-DM eviction reports open for new proof.

recommendation.title: TTL-aware protection plus Feishu repair
recommendation.body: Protect active or recent direct DM sessions from maintenance while adding Feishu `open_id` validation and a doctor or migration path for malformed existing keys.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current routing candidate for the session-maintenance policy surface, with Feishu-specific input likely needed from the plugin owner afterward.
